mostWorthwhile.text: Punching the star disc and fitting it onto the spindle made the projector's central assembly understandable through a clear sequence.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated fittings and flips became somewhat routine, especially with only one gameplay option at each of these steps.

surprise.text: The box was called a projector immediately after the reflector was fitted, before the wheel, lamp, or battery were installed.

arbitrary.text: Turning the star wheel to its loading side initially lacked an explanation, although the following instruction to lower it into the bearings gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would probably not continue based on this text pass alone: the assembly is clear, but the mostly prescribed sequence offers little choice. I cannot assess the artwork or working animation here.
